title: Support draft activity must return a blocked draft on its last attempt, never raise
answers: support ticket stuck on Processing forever
ticket stays in_progress after AI draft fails
what happens when the draft agent returns no JSON
how many retries does the support draft activity get
body:
Symptom: a support ticket stays on "Processing" (status in_progress) forever when the AI draft agent ends with no message, a prose status sentence instead of JSON, or the agent server crashes.
Root cause: products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_draft_async raised on every attempt; after the last retry the SupportReplyWorkflow failed before it recorded a result, so the ticket never left in_progress.
Fix pattern: route every failure through draft.py:_give_up. While llm_attempts() < DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS it raises DraftNotProducedError so Temporal retries. On the last attempt it returns SupportReplyDraft(reply="", confidence=0.0, verdict="blocked_on_knowledge"). That draft never auto-sends, so a person picks the ticket up. task_run_id is "" when no session was started.
Constraints: products/conversations/backend/temporal/pipeline.py:SupportReplyWorkflow must use RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS) from constants.py, so the activity and the policy agree on which attempt is last. The value stays 2 because changing it affects workflow replay. Any new failure path in the draft activity should call _give_up instead of raising.
applies: products/conversations AI reply draft activity and its Temporal retry policy
